entries.title: Reducing latency in highly scalable HPC applications via accelerator-resident runtime management
entries.provenance: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; U.S. patent application publication
entries.lesson: Shared dependency state and local scheduling can reduce orchestration latency; runtime reassignment should remain observable and bounded.

entries.title: Enhancement of retrieval augmented generation using geospatial data
entries.provenance: Chevron U.S.A. Inc.; U.S. patent application publication
entries.lesson: Detect domain-specific intent, route to a specialist retrieval layer, and inject structured records as grounded context.

entries.title: Distribution of query-based tasks to on-network AI models
entries.lesson: Discover model capabilities, decompose a query, route subtasks to specialists, and reconcile outputs.

entries.title: Agentic artificial intelligence for interactive and incremental software development
entries.lesson: Use checkpointed intermediate states, interaction-driven revision, and traceable progression toward a final artifact.

entries.title: Methods, apparatus and systems for network configuration
entries.provenance: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (publ); U.S. patent application publication
entries.lesson: Generate multiple proposals, predict effects in simulation/digital twin, then gate real-world changes.

entries.title: Multimodal-based human-computer interaction method and system thereof
entries.lesson: Dynamic multimodal weighting can improve interaction, but sensitive inference requires privacy constraints and explicit scope.
